description: This file defines the class RejectedPromise, which represents a rejected promise in the GuzzleHttp\Promise library. It implements methods to handle promise rejection, chaining, and state management.

classes.name: RejectedPromise
classes.description: A class representing a promise that has been rejected, providing methods to handle and propagate rejection states.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a rejected promise with a specified reason, disallowing the reason to be a promise.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Chains handlers to the promise, invoking onRejected callback if provided.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Adds an onRejected handler to the promise, equivalent to calling then with null for onFulfilled.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks until the promise is resolved or rejected; throws exception if $unwrap is true.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise, which is 'REJECTED'.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Throws exception as a rejected promise cannot be resolved.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Ensures the reason matches the current reason; otherwise throws an exception.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: A no-op method for canceling the promise.
